zh.title: 阿聯酋航空在杜拜機場B候機區啟用臨時頭等艙貴賓室
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空第三航廈B候機區的臨時頭等艙貴賓室已於11月18日開放，預計使用約一年後改供商務艙旅客使用。
body: 阿聯酋航空在杜拜國際機場第三航廈B候機區啟用臨時頭等艙貴賓室，11月18日起接待旅客。航空公司預計讓這處設施服務頭等艙旅客約一年，再轉作商務艙貴賓室。
這座貴賓室是阿聯酋航空斥資4億阿聯酋迪拉姆翻新杜拜旗艦貴賓室的一環。B、C候機區的永久頭等艙設施預計於2027年陸續開放。

en.title: Emirates opens temporary first-class lounge at Dubai’s Concourse B
en.summary: The Terminal 3 lounge opened on November 18 and is expected to serve first-class passengers for about a year.
body: Emirates has opened a temporary first-class lounge at Concourse B in Dubai International Airport’s Terminal 3. It began welcoming passengers on November 18. The airline plans to use the space for first class for about a year before converting it to a business-class lounge.
The opening is part of a 400 million dirham programme to renovate Emirates’ flagship lounges in Dubai. Permanent first-class facilities in Concourses B and C are scheduled to open in 2027.
